source: applied rewrites from the independent-critic rounds over the Eternal card lines, re-applied and re-verified on every ingest

sparrow:carry.Your cleanup. Once a hero drops low, mis: Your cleanup. Once a hero drops low, missiles chase them through walls to finish runners. Wind-Rider adds attack speed as Heightened Senses ends your Stealth.

ikra:midlane.Every Brine, Narcosis and Genesis hit le: Every Brine, Narcosis and Genesis hit adds extra damage over time, so keep poking with bubble pops. Lich heals you off that ability damage.

steel:offlane.Rewards staying on one hero. Stun them w: Rewards staying on one hero. Stun them with Shield Bash or Shield Slam, then land three Punches in a row; Crush adds damage when a stun lands, on a cooldown.

renna:midlane.Lane poke pays: each Soulfire or Stupor: Lane poke pays: Soulfire or Stupor hits on heroes earn gold, and every cast builds mana regen. Runic Focus adds power while your mana bar stays high.

serath:jungle.Your finisher: once a target falls under: Once a target falls under 30%, missiles chase them through walls, so don't chase them out of sight. Wind-Rider's attack speed after Heaven's Fury teleports you adds extra missiles.

shinbi:jungle.Rushing Beat, Line Tempo and All-Kill! h: Rushing Beat, Line Tempo and All-Kill! hits add a bit of extra damage over time after your burst. Lich heals you off that damage.

neon:midlane.Boosts the stats on every item you buy,: Boosts the stats on every item you buy, so it grows stronger as your build fills out. Memory Leak grows your mana pool as you cast L.I.N.X and Data Burst.
neon:midlane.Each L.I.N.X or Data Burst that hits a h: Every cast builds mana regen, and each L.I.N.X or Data Burst that hits a hero earns gold, so poke often in lane. Runic Focus adds power while mana stays high.

revenant:carry.Your items give more stats, so finish ea: Your items give more stats, so finish each item before buying the next. Tri-Core adds extra damage of a random type to every Fate shot, which suits Revenant's basic attacks.

the-fey:support.Harvest Nettles and Untamed Growth hits: Every cast stacks mana regen, which Arcane Resonance turns into faster cooldowns, and Harvest Nettles or Untamed Growth hits on heroes earn gold. Philosopher adds steady gold while you roam.

grux:jungle.A finisher: once a hero drops low, missi: Once a hero drops low, missiles chase them through walls for a little extra damage to help finish runners. Dryad's Boon lets each club swing bring Double Pain back sooner.

boris:jungle.Mark whoever you're hitting and stay on: Mark whoever you're basic attacking and stay on them: you deal more damage to them and take less from them. Savage Strikes heals you as you keep hitting.

adele:offlane.Extra health and size let you stay in fi: Extra health and size let you stay in fights while Iron Rose's vine keeps chipping. Brawl up front longer; Cannibalism grows your health with every takedown.

drongo:carry.Once a hero drops under 30%, missiles ch: Once a hero drops under 30%, missiles chase them through walls, so don't chase out of sight. Taproot heals you each Lucy shot, and Forage adds gold and XP.

feng-mao:jungle.Takedowns add random bonuses, and Reapin: Takedowns add random bonuses and also cut most of Reaping Dash's cooldown, so dive on kills and chain them. Masterpiece stacks damage and speed with each kill.

crunch:offlane.Every ability cast weakens nearby enemy: Every cast weakens nearby enemy heroes' damage, and Crunch casts constantly, so stay close and keep chaining abilities. Harmonic Currents restores some missing health and mana.

dekker:support.Ability hits on heroes earn gold and sta: Every cast stacks mana regen, which Arcane Resonance converts into faster cooldowns, and ability hits on heroes earn gold. Philosopher keeps gold coming even on quiet stretches.

countess:offlane.Casting keeps mana regeneration flowing,: Casting keeps mana regeneration flowing, and hero damage pays extra gold. Trade with Blade Siphon and Eventide often; Sacrifice tops up some mana whenever your abilities hit a hero.

countess:jungle.Your abilities leave an extra burn on to: Your abilities add extra damage over time on top of Haemorrhage, so hit with Shadow Slip and Eventide before chasing. Tithe of Death adds ability haste per takedown.

zinx:offlane.Marks whoever your Refibrillator shots h: Marks whoever your Refibrillator shots hit, so pick one laner and keep shooting them. Ferocity adds attack speed in long fights, stacking Refibrillator's damage faster.

skylar:carry.Turns your attacks into a finisher: hit: Hit a low-health hero and missiles chase them through walls, adding a little damage that can finish runners. Forage adds gold and XP from every farm kill.

greystone:jungle.Extra health gives Stoicism more room to: Extra health lets you dive in and soak hits for your team, and Stoicism's armor and regen grow as you lose health. Cannibalism adds health with every takedown.

wraith:carry.Knock, Knock! and Peekaboo! keep burning: Knock, Knock! and Peekaboo! keep burning after they land, adding chip to your long-range poke. Tithe of Death restores some mana and adds ability haste with each takedown.

murdock:offlane.Once a hero drops under 30%, missiles ch: Once a hero drops under 30%, your next hit fires missiles that chase them through walls, so keep poking runners. Taproot heals you on each Enforcer shot.

narbash:support.Rewards a support who keeps allies toppe: Anyone you heal or shield attacks faster and hits harder briefly, but Narbash's songs grant health regeneration, not direct heals, so it may rarely trigger. Omnipresent speeds your roams.

muriel:support.Your attacks and abilities strip enemy a: Your attacks and abilities strip enemy armor and give you part of it. With Peal, hits right after Reversal Of Fortune apply full stacks, so land and hit everyone.
muriel:support.Every Alacrity shield and Consecrated Gr: Every Alacrity shield arms the ally it touches with faster, harder-hitting attacks. Shield your carry as they start shooting; Revelation brings basic cooldowns back sooner.

eden:offlane.Once a hero drops under 30%, missiles ch: Once a hero drops under 30%, missiles chase them through walls, so don't chase out of sight. Taproot heals on each basic attack; Forage adds gold and XP.

scarlett:offlane.Heals you more the lower you get, so you: Heals you more the lower you get, so you can keep dueling while low. Roses pays more gold as your takedowns add up and boosts that healing after hero kills.

morigesh:offlane.Mark, Hive and Swarm hits on heroes earn: Every cast stacks mana regen, which Arcane Resonance turns into faster cooldowns, and Mark, Hive and Swarm hits on heroes earn gold. Keep steady pressure on your lane opponent.

yin:jungle.Your finisher. Once a target drops low,: Once a hero drops low, missiles chase them through walls, adding a little damage that can finish runners. Forage adds gold and XP; Taproot heals you every swing.

phase:support.Essence Catalyst heals you and your link: Each heal or shield you give boosts that ally's attack speed and adds magic damage to their basic attacks, so link your carry and keep them topped up.
phase:support.Casting builds mana and pays gold off he: Casting builds mana and pays some gold off hero damage, helping you afford items as support. Perfection gives extra ability haste while you're healthy, so stay out of enemy poke.

maco:support.Each cast stacks mana regeneration, and: Each cast stacks mana regeneration and hero damage pays extra gold, so poke with Maco Sparkle! and Maco Gift! often; Arcane Resonance then brings basic abilities back faster.

wukong:jungle.Once a hero drops under 30%, missiles ch: Once a hero drops under 30%, missiles chase them through walls. Pole Vault's leap triggers Wind-Rider for extra attack speed and missiles, and Forage adds gold and XP per kill.
wukong:jungle.Stick to one target with basic attacks t: Stick to one target with basic attacks to keep the mark on them. Ferocity stacks attack speed in long fights; Alpha's Court adds damage when no ally is near.

valmont:midlane.Rupture and Exsanguinate hits on heroes: Every cast stacks mana regen, easing Exsanguinate's rising mana cost, and ability hits on heroes earn gold. Sacrifice restores mana on hero hits; Runic Focus favors high mana.

yurei:jungle.Random bonuses build over time and with: Random bonuses build over time and with each takedown. Chain Severance resets to secure kills, and Masterpiece's speed after kills reaches the next target.
